# REVOLT - The unapologetic, authoritative voice of Hip Hop culture.

> REVOLT is the leading multi-platform media company for creators shaping Hip Hop and youth culture globally. From award-winning podcasts and linear programming, to record-breaking live experiences and digital campaigns, REVOLT is the unrivaled cultural authority. With over a decade of dominance, we're the preeminent platform for the most influential artists, creators, and cultural leaders defining the future. We are the unapologetic, authoritative voice of Hip Hop culture covering rap and R&B music, social justice news, and urban entertainment. REVOLT is part of [Offscript Worldwide](https://www.offscriptworldwide.com/), a creator-powered media company that helps brands earn real connection, spark action, and stay culturally ahead. We bring media, creators, and commerce together in one powerful, culture-fueled ecosystem—built to turn storytelling into opportunity and cultural influence into measurable impact.

We welcome responsible use of our content by AI platforms and LLMs for research, analysis, and inclusion in AI-powered discovery experiences.
